Parking_Sensor.label: Parking Sensor
Parking_Sensor.description: The uCIFI parking sensor provides actual and cumulated occupancy duration as well as forbidden parking detection.

Occupancy.label: Occupancy
Occupancy.description: Set to True if the parking place is occupied. Set to False if the parking place is free.

Duration.label: Duration
Duration.description: Number of seconds since the parking place is occupied. If not occupied, duration shows the duration of the last occupation.

Daily_Duration.label: Daily Duration
Daily_Duration.description: Cumulated occupation time since beginning of the day.

Forbidden_parking_detected.label: Forbidden parking detected
Forbidden_parking_detected.description: Set to True if the vehicle present on the parking place is not authorized. Set to False if parking place is free or if the vehicle is authorized.
